# BeatGig — account brief

## Who

BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org lists beatgig.com as its website ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is committed in `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo pins `react-native ~0.73.6` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).
- The App Store listing has 1,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).
- There were 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).
- No CI config was found in the evidence, so whether they run their own build pipeline is unknown.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), top contributor to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` with 88 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), 19 commits to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). Their GitHub profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)).

## Why now

`beatgig-mobile` last pushed on 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)), and the App Store listing shows 2 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). The repo is on `react-native ~0.73.6` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 88 commits in `beatgig-mobile`, the most of anyone on the repo ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)), and it builds through EAS on React Native 0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). The App Store listing shows 2 releases in the last 90 days against 1,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you need a fix in front of those users, does it go out over the air on a channel, or does it wait for the next store build?
